## Description
Provide a clear summary of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number) or Addresses #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] UI/UX enhancement (visual polish or interaction improvement)
- [ ] Documentation update (README, AGENTS.md, etc.)
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Tests (adding missing tests or refactoring test suite)

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code conforms to the style guidelines of this project (`cargo fmt -- --check`).
- [ ] I have run `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and resolved all warnings.
- [ ] I have run `cargo test` and all 23+ tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified offline diagnostics via `cargo run -- --check`.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or bilingual strings if applicable.
